messages:
Alex R.: Quick sync — planning an "adoption runway" + clear exit thresholds for new models in the catalog. Need both onboarding gates and a deprecation/migration playbook. TL;DR: propose quantitative gates + timeline rules so PMs and SREs have a predictable flow.
Maria L.: +1. Can we make a small, standard checklist so each model doesn't invent its own gates? I'm thinking: perf, quality, cost, infra readiness, and legal/privacy checks.
Raj P.: For perf I suggest concrete numbers we can iterate on: p95 latency <= 250ms on targeted infra, error rate <0.2%, and memory footprint within expected GPU profile. If any of these fail in canary -> hold rollout.
Jin W.: Quality gating: eval pass rate >= 97% on the seed prompt set used for that family; delta vs baseline <= 1.5% absolute on our primary metric. A/B ramping requires min N=10k impressions OR 2 weeks active traffic (whichever comes first).
Sophie K.: Pinning policy idea: default pin window = 30 days after onboarding. Pins prevent automatic swaps during that window. Exceptions: security/regressions can extend pin to 90d. When a pin expires the model goes into "grace-phase" for 14 days (compat shim + reduced traffic) before full deprecation.
Maria L.: Deprecation flow proposal: 60-day public notice -> 30-day optional customer canary/migration window -> 14-day auto-fallback period -> final removal. We'll include migration assistance offers for enterprise customers.
Alex R.: Rollback criteria (operational): if bad_quality_rate increases by >1.0 percentage point OR latency p95 regresses by >2x OR error rate above 0.5% sustained for 30m -> immediate rollback to previous pinned variant and incident channel.
Raj P.: Putting the core thresholds into a quick snippet we can copy into the playbook:
```
GATES = {
  "latency_p95_ms": "250",
  "error_rate_pct": "0.2",
  "quality_delta_pct": "1.5",
  "min_ab_samples": "10000",
  "cost_uplift_pct": "150"
}
```
Jin W.: Also suggest adding an "adoption runway" metric: 30-day retention of model calls (>=50%) and incremental usage growth target. If adoption is < threshold after 45 days, auto-trigger a review to either iterate prompts, add quantization advice, or flag for deprecation.
deploy-bot: Canary launched: catalog-canary-2109876543 -> 10% traffic routed. Monitoring hooks active.
Sophie K.: Action items: Alex = write policy doc (canonical); Raj = infra checklist and p95 test harness; Jin = canonical seed prompt sets + eval harness; Maria = customer comms templates and deprecation notices; I'll coordinate enterprise migration playbook.
Alex R.: I'll draft the doc today and open a PR in docs-repo (docs/catalog/lifecycle). Reviewers: @Maria L., @Raj P., @Jin W., @Sophie K. Sync to review Thu 10am. :thumbsup:
